messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] Sev2 - us-west-2 - inference-pool-6. Spike: pod restarts x18 in 10m, OOMs + CUDA errors. Auto-thread created. Trigger: paged-allocator OOM rate. Link: https://internal.ops/incidents/1717659999

mike_oncall: seeing it. 10:02 UTC - graphs show resident_pages climbing steady on a subset of nodes. Rolling restarts happening. I'm grabbing logs.

mike_oncall: logs snippet:
```
E 10:03:12 cuda: CudaMalloc failed: out of memory
W 10:03:12 kv_cache: resident_pages=32768 quota=32000 slab_fragmentation=0.62
E 10:03:13 paged_allocator: allocation failed for seq=4096 tokens
```

sara_infra: immediate mitigation idea - throttle new requests to inference-pool-6, set MAX_CONCURRENCY=1 for that pool and flip PAGED_KV_ENABLED=false on a small canary set. That should lower new pressure.

jin_research: adding context - we saw similar steady growth locally when sequence lengths mix 512/4096. Fragmentation + stale mapped pages not being reclaimed. Compaction cadence can lag under high churn. Repro steps posted to the repo gist.

alex_sre: runbook steps: 1) scale down concurrency 2) trigger KV scavenge on affected nodes 3) apply hot-patch to allocator to force eager compaction. Endpoint: POST https://admin.internal/kv/evict?policy=scavenge (auth required). I'm running evict on two nodes now.

mike_oncall: evict API responded 200 on node-6a and node-6b. Eviction logs: "scavenge started, freed ~6.2M pages". Pod restart rate decreased but some nodes still show pressure.

ops_jess: ops impact - we have a ticket from AcmeCorp reporting timeouts and 503s since ~09:58 UTC. They saw degraded tail latency and 10% error rate on many requests. Notified account team; advising on workaround (reduce seq_len).

lina_oncall: handing off next 1.5h watch to me. Checklist I need: confirmation of hot-patch build id, which nodes patched, and whether we need to cordon any nodes.

mike_oncall: hot-patch build: 0.3.7-hotfix-alloc. Currently applying to canary3 -> pool-6 nodes gradually (6a,6b applied). Plan: if no regress in 15m, roll to rest of pool. Cordon plan: cordon node-6c if eviction fails again.

jin_research: short-term patch notes: reduce slab_size from 256MB to 128MB, lower alloc_window to 32, force immediate compaction on free > 60% events. This reduces fragmentation but may increase CPU during compaction.

alex_sre: policy update: set alert for "pod_restart_rate > 5% over 5m" to page oncall instead of email. Also temporarily lower paged allocator quota thresholds to trigger earlier eviction.

ops_jess: customer ops updated AcmeCorp with ETA ~30m for mitigation. Suggested immediate client-side fallback to shorter prompts.

mike_oncall: rolling rollout to remaining nodes started at 10:25 UTC. So far 0 failures on patched nodes. Watching memory graphs and CUDA error counts.

lina_oncall: acknowledged handoff. I'll keep tracking. If we see any node with >10% residual pages after eviction, I'll cordon and replace.

mike_oncall: postmortem note: root suspect = paged KV fragmentation + delayed compaction under mixed seq_len workload leading to slow resident growth -> OOM cascade on some GPUs. Follow-ups: telemetry to expose per-model seq_len distribution, automated periodic compaction, and a conservative default for PAGED_KV_ENABLED.

ops_jess: closing customer loop: AcmeCorp confirmed errors dropped to ~1% after patch and advised they'll re-open if they see regressions.

lina_oncall: last check 10:50 UTC - cluster stable, no new CUDA OOMs in 20m. I'll keep the watch for another hour then update incident ticket.

mike_oncall: pausing background experiments against pool-6 until we ship a longer-term allocator fix. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
